about_the_game:
The Oversight Bureau welcomes you to orientation day. In this free demo, we're excited to share a pre-alpha glimpse at the opening levels of the game and let you explore the secrets of the C.U.T.E programme. 

C.U.T.E: Cognitive Utility Training Environment

You are candidate 404. This is not the name your mother gave you but the one you’ve now been assigned. They said you volunteered - but at the end of the day, attendance is mandatory and compliance is compulsory. 

Good news: You will remain in the C.U.T.E. programme until you’ve demonstrated yourself to be a more appropriate, more compliant member of society. In even better news, you will be eligible for reintegration in 13,674 days.

Day in, day out, you run the gauntlet. Enduring simulations designed to strip away who you are, and become who you could be. The programme is the first of its kind, and prides itself on being a sans-human facility.

There will be no escaping, 404. The only way out is through...

A voice-driven narrative adventure

In The Oversight Bureau, you'll talk to and collaborate with the unique characters around the facility and uncover the secrets of the Bureau. You'll undergo psychological evaluations, be put on the spot with crisis training exercises, and navigate elaborate puzzle chambers with the C.U.T.E robots by your side. At the end of each day, you can return to your hub to rest and, depending on your performance, receive some bureau-approved Screen Time.

Iconic's Narrative Engine runs entirely on-device on almost any PC (as long as you have a mic!), and allows you to talk to our characters without waiting for responses. This is not a chatbot - experience the crafted story in your own words.

NOTE: The quality of the demo is not reflective of the final quality of the game. We are sharing an early version to get feedback from our community on this brand new input method, and are excited to use it to make the full game even better.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: 4 cores, Intel Haswell / Excavator or newer
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Microphone required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 5600 / Intel i5-12400F
  • Graphics: AMD RX 6800 XT / Nvidia RTX 3080
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Microphone required

short_description: The Oversight Bureau is a voice-driven narrative adventure game. You are candidate 404, trapped inside C.U.T.E. - a rehabilitation program designed to make you a more “appropriate” member of society. As time ticks away and days blur, escape is the only way to keep your sanity and your voice, 404.
